entries.name: walk
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
IMAGE 1: COLOR AND COSTUME REFERENCE ONLY. Black steel armor, brass trim, closed cyan-slit helmet, red cape.
IMAGE 2: THE EXACT POSES TO EDIT. This is the walking sprite sheet. Repaint image 2 with the costume of image 1 while keeping image 2's sixteen distinct upright WALKING poses, body angles and limb positions. Do not copy image 1's bent-over running poses. The character walks upright with a straight chest, head directly above the hips, legs extending down, no running crouch, no high lifted back heel.
Output exactly the same 8-column / 2-row sixteen-frame sequence as image 2 with the same foot positions and identical human proportions between frames. Two alternating walking steps, heels roll to toes, natural passing leg bends, near leg alternates in front and behind. A single steel sword rests angled down behind the near hand, pointing LEFT and down, never multiple blades. Cape hangs down the back to around knee height and sways modestly. Pixel game art consistent with a 60px tall full character. Stable hips centered in all cells; baseline fixed; do not rescale individual frames; all body parts inside each roomy cell. Right-facing pure side view. Transparent PNG. No text, ground shadows, labels, grids, particle glows, extra objects.

entries.name: walk-unarmed
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the UNARMED version of this walking sprite sheet. Remove all swords, blades, sword hilts and crossguards from all sixteen frames. Near hand becomes a relaxed closed fist and the empty forearm swings gently with the gait. Preserve the exact leg, knee, boot and pelvis positions, gait order, near/far shading, upright posture, blacksteel armor with brass trim, helmet cyan slit and red cape in every corresponding frame. No visible weapon anywhere. Do not alter the walking poses or scale, do not revert to running. Keep the same transparent 8-column, 2-row atlas with sixteen complete figures, same figure placement and cell geometry. No extra objects, floor, shadows, text, glow or labels.

entries.name: sprint
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a 16-frame blacksteel knight running sprite sheet, 8 columns by 2 rows. Preserve the EXACT leg and boot positions, gait poses, torso positions, cape, armor identity, camera, cell layout and transparent background. Change ONLY the sword rendering: every knight must carry exactly ONE longsword, held in the near hand with the blade extending backward to the LEFT and slightly downward behind his hips, in the same manner as most frames already do. Remove the erroneous second blade that extends forward/right across the legs in the first pose of the top row and any other duplicate blades. Do not add a second sword, sheath, glow, loose pixels or equipment. Uniform single blade length and angle throughout the sequence. Maintain every pose and all 16 complete figures. Transparent PNG.

entries.name: sprint-unarmed
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 16-frame running animation atlas into an UNARMED variant. Change ONLY: remove every sword, blade, hilt, guard and scabbard; close the now-empty near hand in a natural relaxed fist. KEEP ALL 16 complete original full-body poses pixel aligned to the original cells. Keep exact hip, leg, knee and boot positions, near/far leg shading, armor, proportions, helmet cyan slit, crimson cape and torso placement. Do not redraw the gait into different poses. No weapons of any kind, detached lines, halos or extra equipment. Preserve genuinely transparent background, exact same sheet size, 8-column 2-row layout, figure scale and constant pelvis anchors. This is the same animation with only weapons removed.

sprint_base_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target image 1 is an existing SIXTEEN FRAME run-cycle sprite sheet (8 columns by 2 rows). Preserve EVERY frame's distinct leg pose and the precise sequential two-step running gait from image 1. This pose template is the most important instruction. Image 2 is only a costume reference for the new blacksteel / brass / crimson-cape knight.
Redraw the 16 complete figures from image 1 wearing the costume from image 2: black articulated steel armor, restrained brass rims, closed helmet with cyan slit, crimson cape, a steel sword held low pointing forward, slim athletic human proportions.
Keep the correct alternating feet, the original silhouettes of hips/knees/boots and the complete near-leg-forward / far-leg-forward / passing poses of target image 1. DO NOT replace these poses with the repeated stance in image 2. Make one continuous looping run cycle. Each knee bends in the natural forward direction, feet lift clear during the recovery swing, planted leg extends behind before the toe lifts. The near leg must visibly move both in front of AND behind the pelvis over the cycle. No limping, hopping on one leg, repeated same stance, tiny flickering feet, extra limbs, detached equipment, or glows. Match identity and armor between all 16 frames.
Output transparent PNG sprite atlas, EXACTLY 8 columns and 2 rows, equally sized roomy cells with a constant pelvis anchor and consistent baseline, side view facing RIGHT. All 16 poses fully visible and separated. No text, numbers, boxes, environment or ground shadows. Pixel-art game sprites ready for native 60px-tall scale.
